titre: Plus de 20 millions de voitures électriques vendues en 2025
sous_titre: Ventes de voitures électriques par marché, année 2025, en millions d unités

Chine.texte: More than 13 million electric cars were sold in China in 2025, maintaining its position as the world's largest electric car market

Europe.texte: electric car sales numbered 1 million more in 2025 than in the previous year, reaching a total of 4.2 million

Reste du monde.texte: electric car sales increased steadily to reach 2 million in 2025

États-Unis.texte: Electric car sales in the United States in 2025 were slightly lower than in 2024, at around 1.5 million
